verdict.rationale: Verbatim text was extracted from several DPMA English guidance pages (trade mark application, patent application, e-filing), which suggests the public reading surface returns readable server-side content. However, there is no direct probe of www.dpma.de recording HTTP status, user agent or the absence of a CAPTCHA. The only probe covers the separate register.dpma.de search host, whose robots.txt disallows all crawling, and that is not the guidance surface. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 for a keyless identified user agent on the guidance pages, confirmation that there is no bot wall, CAPTCHA or JS-only shell, and robots.txt permission for the guidance host.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
